name: ZECCHINETTA
description: Zecchinetta (Lansquenet) is an Italian banking/gambling game. Banker vs players. 40-card Italian deck. Banker deals 2 player cards + 1 banker card face-up. Players bet on player cards. Banker draws cards: match player card = banker pays; match banker card = banker wins all bets. New unmatched cards become additional betting options.

content.text: Zecchinetta (Lansquenet) is an Italian banking/gambling game. Banker vs players. 40-card Italian deck. Banker deals 2 player cards + 1 banker card face-up. Players bet on player cards. Banker draws cards: match player card = banker pays; match banker card = banker wins all bets. New unmatched cards become additional betting options.

Zecchinetta is the Italian variant of Lansquenet, one of Europe's oldest recorded banking games. Lansquenet is named after the German Landsknecht (medieval mercenary) and appears in Rabelais' Gargantua (1542). The Italian form became especially associated with Sicily and southern Italy and was carried to the USA by Italian immigrants as Ziginette. Traditionally played with a 40-card Italian pack, it remains popular in private play in Italy despite being illegal in public places.

items.text: First banker by ace: First banker is chosen by dealing cards around until a player receives an ace.
